mentions.name: Mainframe-style job scheduling workflow engine
mentions.description: A workflow engine modeled on old mainframe-era job scheduling systems (OPC/TWS/CA7) rather than Airflow-like tools, with the stated hope of eventually becoming an Airflow killer by reviving the conceptual strengths of those legacy schedulers.
mentions.problem: The author views current server and cloud workflow tools as conceptually inferior to mainframe-era job scheduling systems.
mentions.source_excerpt: A workflow engine, but not an "airflow like" (even if I hope it will become an airflow killer) but more similar to old job scheduling systems from mainframe era(OPC/TWS/CA7 ecc).

evidence.value: A workflow engine, but not an "airflow like" (even if I hope it will become an airflow killer) but more similar to old job scheduling systems from mainframe era(OPC/TWS/CA7 ecc).
